difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the quotient of a smooth groupoid in functors on the category of Artinian algebras by an equivalence relation whose objects and arrows both satisfy (RS) again satisfies (RS) (statement lines 6713-6717). The proof (proof lines 6719-6789) translates a diagram in the quotient into explicit data, uses smoothness of the source map to lift an arrow and (RS) for the objects to build the candidate fibre product, and verifies the universal property using (RS) for the arrows. H3: an original construction of a fibre product in a quotient groupoid with a full universal property check, written out in full.
